status_note: CAPABILITY CHECK (unscored for the comparison). QUEUED, dispatch disabled. Shows per arm that the request is accepted with an image, that the answer parses, and which model identity is served. 4 of the 40 published cases (one per slice), 1 trial; these exposures are recorded and the cases stay in the comparison set.

case_set.role: diagnostic and compatibility set; public since 2026-09; exposure disclosed in every report

protocol.task: run_eval.TASK_PROMPT unchanged (transcription reading; see protocol/PROTOCOL.md section 3)
protocol.image_policy: the stored PNG bytes, media type image/png, no resizing or re-encoding by the harness; provider-side resizing is recorded where the provider reports it
protocol.context_policy: one fresh single-turn request per attempt; no system prompt; no earlier turns; no reference labels; no other arm's output

arms.role: one Claude vision configuration (fresh arm; the historical two-Claude results are history, not this arm)
arms.notes: sampling empty = provider default, as in the v1 harness; record the served model string and usage

detail is explicit because the documented default is auto. If the chosen model is a reasoning model, max_output_tokens must cover reasoning tokens (the v1 harness used 25,000 for o-series); decide before freezing

arms.role: one open-weight VISION configuration, local only; the candidate model is chosen only after its image input is shown by the capability check
arms.notes: Orca and the local models are occupied as of 2026-10-26; nothing here was called. If the runtime is OpenAI-compatible instead, change provider to openai_compatible_local and state the endpoint. A text-plus-OCR pipeline is a separate system arm, not this one.
